notes: Biophysics is an optional focus area within the BS, Physics (PY29) degree. Full requirement set = BS Physics core plus five restricted electives from the biophysics focus list. Focus list verified verbatim.

buckets.label: Upper-Division Lab
buckets.note: One from PHYS 122, 124, 133, 173, or ASTR 150 (4 units). PHYS 173 is a natural lab choice for biophysics.

buckets.label: Restricted Electives (Biophysics focus)
buckets.note: Five restricted electives (20 units), 4+ units each; max two from outside physics. Catalog verbatim: 'Biophysics: PHYS 140B, 173, 175, 176, 177, 178; BI** 100-185; CHEM 100-186.' 'BI 100-185' = any BI-prefixed upper-division course 100-185.

buckets.label: Total Units for the Major
buckets.note: 52 lower-division + 57 upper-division units (same as base BS). Minimum total-unit requirement for the BS Physics (with Biophysics specialization), not a course list. Per the bucket note and UCSD catalog (PHYS-ug.html), the major totals ~109 units = 52 lower-division (PHYS 4A-E, 2CL, 2DL, 41; MATH 18, 20A-E) + 57 upper-division (PHYS 100A-B, 105A, 110A, 120, 130A-B, 140A core; one upper-div lab; five restricted biophysics electives). Satisfied by accumulating the required units across all other buckets; leave courses empty.
